what_it_does: Intel SGX is a special walled-off secure area inside a processor where sensitive code runs isolated from the rest of the system and even from the operating system. While this isolation is powerful, bugs inside the secure area itself can still undermine security. This paper presents IntraFuzz, the first tool to find these bugs automatically by testing the code inside the secure area on real SGX hardware. The tool works like a fuzz tester (which bombards code with random inputs to find crashes) but feeds coverage information—which code paths have been explored—back into the fuzzer to be more strategic about what to test next.
